thread:
Anya (product): Quick sync — we need to shrinkwrap the MVP to hit end-of-month. Draft cuts: 1) remove multi-tenant SSO (defer to v1), 2) pause analytics export (CSV/BI), 3) collapse admin bulk-edit into single-edit. Keep embeddings cache and routing. Thoughts?
Marco (eng): +1 on removing multi-tenant SSO, saves ~2w of integration + e2e. Heads-up: Acme has a SSO pilot request.
Dana (sales): Acme will push back if we cut SSO. Can we offer a tethered pilot on Dedicated instead?
Anya (product): We can offer a Dedicated pilot + acceptance criteria as a stopgap. That should unblock launch for most customers. @Dana can you confirm with AE?
Dana (sales): I'll flag to AE and craft a short pilot script + SLA. :memo: Need clarity on what we promise.
Marco (eng): Cutting exports reduces backend work ~4d and frontend ~3d. If we keep a lightweight dashboard view (no CSV) that might be acceptable for early customers.
SRE Bot: FYI — code freeze window starts at 3212348800. Any scope changes should land before freeze or require exception.
Anya (product): Plan: 1) confirm Dedicated pilot path, 2) update canary plan to run auth changes behind flag, 3) publish rebaselined milestone doc today. @Marco @Dana can you update PRs/comms?
Marco (eng): Will update milestone PR and add rollback/runbook steps. ETA: EOD.
Dana (sales): I'll draft customer comms and the pilot acceptance checklist this afternoon.
Anya (product): :thumbsup: If no objections, reconvene tomorrow 10am for final signoff.
notes: short thread; coordination between product/eng/sales about MVP scope cuts and mitigation via Dedicated pilot
